presented_options.B: the two earliest rows — only WAL records that survive the CRC check are replayed; the trailing one is dropped

answers.rationale: recover_from_wal only returns page writes for transactions in committed_txns (those with a COMMIT record); absent COMMIT means the txn's writes are discarded entirely.
